summary.en: Shorter songs, cheaper gear, DIY labels against prog and arena scale.
summary.zh: 更短的歌、更便宜的器材、DIY 厂牌，对抗 Prog 与体育馆规模。

body.en: Punk reacts to Prog length and arena rock economics. It favors speed, attitude, and playable songs, and feeds Post-Punk, hardcore, and later Indie DIY scenes.
body.zh: Punk 反击 Prog 曲长与 Arena Rock 经济。它强调速度、态度与易上手歌曲，并直接催生后朋克、Hardcore，以及日后 Indie 的 DIY 场景。
